name: Jöel Zaldívar
office: City of West Hollywood, Member of the City Council

items.text: Jöel Zaldívar is a business owner. He says he holds bachelor’s degrees in political science and international studies.

sentences.text: Jöel Zaldívar is a business owner.
He says he holds bachelor’s degrees in political science and international studies.

items.text: He proposes creating a Commercial Rent Stabilization Division to address commercial leases and the growing prices of goods and services. He wants to form a West Hollywood Police Department, saying the city relies too much on Los Angeles for policing. He also proposes a Universal Parking Pass for residents and an overhaul of the residential parking division. Zaldívar does not support renewing the city’s contract with Flock Safety cameras, citing privacy concerns. He favors the city creating its own Transit Oriented Development Alternative Plan. He opposes the Fountain Avenue bike lane project as currently proposed.
